caveats: ⚑ skill2 escalating tiers: the prose says each subsequent activation ALSO triggers every earlier effect, so from the 3rd burst cast onward three separate elemAdvantageDamagePct windows (20.85%/3s, 13.88%/5s, 8.36%/10s) should be live concurrently and sum additively in the Damage Up bucket. If the buff engine's same-caster-slot overwrite collapses same-stat grants from one caster, the modelled magnitude collapses toward the last-applied step instead — UNVERIFIED, pin with a buffApply-value assertion before trusting the magnitude.

⚑ elemAdvantageDamagePct is live only while the holder has elemental advantage over the boss. The whole skill2 payload is therefore inert on a non-advantaged boss element (Water allies need a Fire boss); it is not a generic attackDamagePct and must not be modelled as one.

skill1's heal is modelled as recovery EVENTS only (5 ticks, 1s apart, per escalating step) — the engine models no HP pool, so the 1.05%/3.69%/6.86%-of-caster-Max-HP magnitudes carry no damage of their own. The line is kept because on-recovery consumers (heal-synergy kits) key off these events, and dropping it would silently break a teammate's trigger.

The burst Max HP grant is ally-scoped; an ally-granted Max HP does not feed a teammate's atkOfMaxHpPct conversion, and this unit carries no HP→ATK scaler of her own, so the grant is offensively inert at present scope. It is retained for kit completeness and for any future consumer.

This unit carries no damage effects at all (no flatDamage/dot/storedHit), so noFb, noRange, core and crit riders are moot — nothing here is a damage rider whose Full-Burst/range/core eligibility could be mis-set.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Mary: Bay Goddess (mary-bay-goddess) is modelled as a pure Water/Supporter Burst I enabler with zero damage effects. skill1 is a team-wide heal-over-time keyed to fullBurstEnter (fires on ANY team Full Burst, per the literal 'when entering Full Burst' clause), authored as an escalating effect whose Nth activation applies steps 1..N — each step a 5-tick, 1s-interval heal so on-recovery consumers stay refreshed. skill2 is keyed to burstCast (the literal 'when using Burst Skill' clause = this unit's own cast, so it only fires on rotations she bursts), targets Water Code allies including herself, and grants escalating Elemental Advantage Attack Damage windows of 20.85%/3s, 13.88%/5s, 8.36%/10s. The burst slot carries two separately-scoped blocks matching the two '■ Affects' headers: ATK ▲23.23% for 3s to Water Code allies (plain 'ATK ▲ x%' = target's own ATK, atkPct), and a caster-scaled Max HP grant of 27.87% of the skill user's final Max HP for 10s to all allies. All three slots are fully represented; unmodeled is empty for every slot.

flags.field: base weapon cadence (SR: ammo 6, reloadFrames 111, chargeFrames 60, hitsPerShot 1)
flags.estimate: Use the datamined values as supplied; effective fire cadence is whatever the engine derives from the SR shot spec, with the 22-frame charge-release latency applied.
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ item 1: datamined rate_of_fire / reloadFrames are known-unreliable fields, and a nominal rate is quantised to 60fps frame boundaries so the effective rate is 60/ceil(60/nominal). This unit contributes no damage effects, so cadence only moves her own weapon damage and her burst-gauge generation — but gauge feeds rotation, so an error here can shift full-burst counts.
flags.recipe: Count trigger pulls and reload gaps for this unit across one magazine in a recorded fight (ammo counter is the direct instrument for shots/sec); compare against the sim's shot events for the same window.

flags.field: skill2.effects[0] — coexistence of the three escalating elemAdvantageDamagePct windows
flags.estimate: Assume all three windows coexist and sum additively in the Damage Up bucket once the 3rd burst cast lands (peak +43.09% for the first 3s after that cast, decaying to +22.24% then +8.36%).
flags.reasoning: The prose states each subsequent effect also triggers every effect before it, and the three grants have distinct magnitudes AND distinct durations — a decaying staircase only makes sense if they coexist. But all three come from the SAME caster and the SAME stat, so the buff engine's same-caster-slot overwrite rule may collapse them to a single live instance, silently changing the magnitude. This is a modelling uncertainty, not a kit-text uncertainty.
flags.recipe: Harness test: run a comp containing this unit plus at least one other Water ally on a Fire boss, capture buffApply events filtered to stat 'elemAdvantageDamagePct', and assert that after the 3rd burstCast three concurrent instances with values 20.85 / 13.88 / 8.36 are live with the stated expiresFrame spread. If the engine collapses them, the honest fix is a per-step key or three separate blocks, not a re-magnituded single buff.

flags.field: skill1 / skill2 escalation tier reached over a 180s fight
flags.estimate: Both escalations saturate at tier 3 well inside the fight — skill1 by the 3rd team Full Burst, skill2 by her 3rd own-burst cast (Burst I, 20s cooldown).
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ item 4 (stack/currency steady-state). The engine's escalating counter derives the tier from actual activations, so no haircut is authored — but the two counters advance on DIFFERENT clocks (any team Full Burst vs her own casts), and in a comp where another Burst I sometimes takes the cast, skill2's counter lags skill1's. Nothing in the kit text pins either count; it is emergent from rotation.
flags.recipe: Read the rotation log (ROT=1) for the graded comp: count team Full Bursts and this unit's own burst casts separately, and confirm the tier-3 windows are live for the fraction of the fight the model assumes.

flags.field: override.burst — burst-cast timing vs the Full Burst window
flags.estimate: Both burst blocks are keyed to burstCast and therefore apply BEFORE the Full Burst window opens; the 3s ATK ▲23.23% window is consumed largely by the pre-FB burst chain rather than by Full Burst uptime.
flags.reasoning: Burst-cast effects land before Full Burst begins, and this unit is Burst I — first in the chain — so a 3s window opening at her cast may expire before or shortly into Full Burst depending on the measured chain timing between stages. The magnitude is kit-exact; only the fraction of Full Burst it actually covers is uncertain, and that is a rotation-timing question, not a kit-reading one.
flags.recipe: Capture buffApply expiresFrame for the atkPct grant alongside fullBurstStart in a rotation log, and confirm the overlap fraction against footage; do not adjust the 23.23% or the 3s to compensate for a timing mismatch.

Hit-Rate→core (item 7) is likewise absent from the kit text.
